lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca2Fe8O16 (reduced formula Ca(FeO2)4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ca adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve O neighbors. The FeO6 octahedra share corners with one another and share faces with Ca-centered 12-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
